title: Background-check results burst
story: A vendor posts results for 5,000 subjects in 5 minutes while the UI reads.
checked: Live read p99 holds; the feed reports every changed subject within the lag bar.
rungNote: At 10k: 250 results in 60 s, about the year-one per-second rate (5,000 / 300 s = 16.7/s) scaled to 4.2/s for a shared slot.
domain: the background-check obligation of each changed subject is re-evaluated (O-DOMAIN)
